title: Tax software security and feature settings
source_system: Tax software admin settings (SYS-01)
what_it_shows: The vendor enforces MFA on every user account; the owner's second factor is an authenticator app on the owner's phone and no second authenticator is registered; the activity log records sign-ins, return access and bank account changes for each user and can be filtered and exported, and no saved or exported activity report appears; the AI document extraction feature is listed and turned off, and its feature page says it uses an AI sub-processor

title: Tax software return, client and e-file reports
source_system: Tax software reporting (SYS-01); owner's filing-season checklist
what_it_shows: 2025 season: about 380 individual returns (Form 1040 series) covering about 600 individual consumers, and about 45 business, trust and estate returns; about 30 client households were part-year Florida residents with a part-year return in another state; the client database holds records from 2014 onward on about 1,450 consumers, current and former clients; the 2026 acknowledgment report lists an accepted or rejected status for every return transmitted under the firm's EFIN, and the filing-season checklist includes a daily acknowledgment check

title: Client portal settings and usage report
source_system: Client portal admin settings (SYS-02)
what_it_shows: Client MFA is set to optional; about 35% of individual clients used the portal in the 2026 season; Forms 8879 and engagement letters are signed with the portal's e-signature, which performs knowledge-based authentication and keeps a signature record; signed Forms 8879 are stored back to 2019; an IRC 7216 consent for release of a return to a lender is set up as a signing template, and the client can save the signed consent and is emailed a copy

title: Email and file suite admin and security pages
source_system: Email and file suite admin console (SYS-03)
what_it_shows: Business plan; the owner's mailbox is the suite's only administrator account; two-step verification is off for the account; basic sign-in methods are allowed; sign-in history and mailbox change records are kept for 30 days; file version history is kept for 30 days and no backup service is connected; the mailbox holds client attachments, and client folders are organized by year back to 2014

title: Email and file suite plan terms and data protection addendum
source_system: Email and file suite admin console (agreements page)
what_it_shows: The business plan terms include a data protection addendum accepted for the account; the provider states that stored data and connections are encrypted

title: Practice management settings, engagement records and payment page
source_system: Practice management admin settings (SYS-04)
what_it_shows: MFA is available and turned off; password sign-in; a signed engagement letter is on file for each 2026 client; engagement types are individual tax, business tax, bookkeeping and payroll, and notice representation, with no audit, review or compilation engagements and no government or federal contractor clients; the engagement letter template says the firm does not accept work that requires protected health information from a covered entity; clients pay by card on the vendor's hosted payment page, and the firm's account shows only payment confirmations

title: Accountant access to clients' accounting files
source_system: Accounting SaaS accountant console (SYS-09)
what_it_shows: The firm's own books are kept in the accounting SaaS; the owner is an accountant user on 12 clients' own accounting files, each added by the client's invitation; the client platforms require a second factor for accountant users, sent to the owner's phone; client payroll runs in the clients' own payroll services

title: Laptop settings review
source_system: Laptop settings screens (SYS-05)
what_it_shows: Full-disk encryption on (turned on in 2023); automatic OS updates on and update history current; built-in antivirus on with real-time protection and automatic signature updates; host firewall on; no backup configured; download folders hold client documents from past seasons; the browser's saved-password list holds the email suite and practice management sign-ins with the same password, and the accountant logins to client accounting files; the IT consultant's remote-support tool is installed

title: Mobile phone settings and content review
source_system: Mobile phone settings screens (SYS-06)
what_it_shows: Passcode set and device encryption on; automatic updates and built-in malware protection on; remote wipe not set up; the camera roll syncs to a personal photo backup account in the owner's name; text threads and the camera roll hold photos of client documents sent by clients; the tax software authenticator, the email app and the generative AI assistant app are on this phone

title: Home office walk-through
source_system: Home office (observation)
what_it_shows: Florida home office in a separate room with a keyed door lock; a locked file cabinet holds paper client files; a cross-cut shredder is in the room; boxes of paper source documents go back to 2019; the printer-scanner is set up for scan-to-email to the owner's mailbox with the mailbox password stored on the device; the appointment calendar shows clients seen in the office by appointment

title: Home router admin page and label
source_system: Internet provider's router (SYS-07)
what_it_shows: One network serves the office laptop and printer-scanner, family phones and tablets, and smart-home devices (connected-device list); a guest network is available and not in use; the admin password in use is the default printed on the router label

title: IT consultant invoices, 2023 to 2026
source_system: Email inbox (SYS-03)
what_it_shows: Hourly invoices at about $120 an hour from 2023 onward for laptop, router, printer-scanner and SaaS help, including the 2023 laptop setup with full-disk encryption and remote sessions on the laptop; a 2024 invoice records turning on mailbox MFA and, the next day, turning it off because the printer-scanner's scan-to-email stopped working; no invoice refers to a services agreement or confidentiality terms

title: IT consultant services agreement and IRC 6713 and 7216 notice
source_system: Signed agreements folder
what_it_shows: Services agreement with confidentiality and security terms signed on 2026-07-23; the consultant signed the written notice of IRC 6713 and 7216 the same day; no earlier agreement or notice was found in the folder or the inbox

title: Agreements and terms inventory
source_system: Signed agreements folder; vendor portals
what_it_shows: Tax software vendor subscription contract (tax preparation, e-file and the portal add-on) with data protection terms; email suite business terms with a data protection addendum; practice management and accounting SaaS click-through subscription terms; the generative AI assistant's individual plan terms; the 2025 contract preparer's short agreement (a retired CPA with a U.S. address) with a confidentiality clause and per-return pay, 2025-02-03 to 2025-04-15; the IT consultant agreement of 2026-07-23; no vendor list and no record of a review of any provider's safeguards

title: Business bank and card statements, 2025-01-01 to 2026-06-30
source_system: Business bank account and card statements
what_it_shows: Recurring payments to the tax software vendor (including the portal add-on), the email and file suite (business plan), the practice management vendor, the accounting SaaS, the generative AI assistant (individual paid plan, monthly from 2026-02), the internet provider, the phone carrier and the professional liability insurer; hourly payments to the IT consultant; per-return payments to the contract preparer from February to April 2025; no payment for a standalone cyber policy, a backup service, a password manager or a security course

title: 2025 Schedule C (Form 1040)
source_system: Owner's tax files
what_it_shows: Principal business code 541211; gross receipts of about $180,000; no wages paid; contract labor paid to the 2025 contract preparer; a sole proprietorship with no employees

title: Practice management fee report, 2025
source_system: Practice management reporting (SYS-04)
what_it_shows: Fees of about $180,000 for 2025, about 60% billed from February to April: about $1,700 per business day in filing season and about $400 per business day in the rest of the year; individual returns and planning about 70% of fees, business returns with bookkeeping and payroll about 20%, and notice representation about 10%

title: PTIN renewals and IRS e-file application
source_system: IRS online PTIN system; IRS e-Services e-file application
what_it_shows: PTIN renewed for 2026 on Form W-12; the 2024, 2025 and 2026 renewals each answered Yes to the line 11 question on keeping a written information security plan; the e-file application lists the firm as an Electronic Return Originator with one EFIN, the owner as Responsible Official and a Florida home office address, and shows the application as current

title: IRS authorizations on file
source_system: IRS Tax Pro Account (authorizations list)
what_it_shows: Active powers of attorney (Form 2848) and tax information authorizations (Form 8821) include about 40 for taxpayers who are no longer clients; none has been withdrawn

title: Search of the owner's files for security documents
source_system: Laptop; email and file suite; paper files
what_it_shows: The IRS Pub. 5708 WISP template downloaded in 2024 was found with no sections filled in; no written security program, Qualified Individual designation, risk assessment, data inventory, vendor list, retention or disposal schedule, device wipe procedure, incident plan or contact list, call-back rule, log review record, change log, continuation agreement, recovery codes or emergency access sheet was found; the IRS Stakeholder Liaison number is not recorded

title: CPE record and security subscriptions
source_system: CPE tracking account; email inbox (SYS-03)
what_it_shows: CPE for the current license cycle includes ethics; no course on information security, phishing or business email compromise appears; no subscription to IRS or Security Summit security alerts appears in the inbox

title: Inbox search: client change requests, attachments and suspicious messages
source_system: Email inbox and sent folder (SYS-03); laptop browser history
what_it_shows: Client emails in the 2026 season asking to change a refund bank account or mailing address were answered by email confirming the change, with no record of a call; on 2026-02-09 a request to change a client's refund account came from her real address, and the owner's reply records a phone call to the number on file and no change made; a 2026-03-09 'new client documents' message links to a look-alike sign-in page for the email suite, the browser history shows the page was opened, and nothing in the sent folder reports it; clients send source documents as attachments, and the sent folder holds completed returns sent as attachments on request

title: Professional liability policy declarations
source_system: Insurance agent portal
what_it_shows: Professional liability coverage in force for 2026 with a data breach expense endorsement listed on the declarations page; no standalone cyber policy; the endorsement's sublimit and conditions are not on the declarations page and were requested from the agent

title: Tax software vendor SOC 2 Type 2 report
source_system: Tax software vendor (provided under a nondisclosure agreement)
what_it_shows: Type 2 report on the Security and Availability categories for the 12 months ending 2026-03-31 with an unqualified opinion; tax preparation, e-file transmission and the client portal module are in scope and the AI document extraction feature is not; the vendor is an Authorized IRS e-file Provider processing in the United States; one exception (2 of 40 sampled departing vendor staff kept access 3 days against a 1-day standard; remediated); backups encrypted, integrity-checked and kept in a second location, tested without exception; RTO 4 hours and RPO 1 hour in the system description; customers notified of security incidents with no number of days stated; the hosting provider is a carved-out subservice organization; complementary user entity controls listed

title: Generative AI assistant account settings and chat history
source_system: Generative AI assistant account (SYS-08)
what_it_shows: Individual paid plan in the owner's name since 2026-02; the setting that lets the vendor use chats to improve its models is on; the chat history runs from 2026-02-02 and includes uploaded PDF documents and pasted text; the phone app is signed in to the same account

title: Generative AI assistant individual plan terms, as accepted
source_system: AI assistant vendor website
what_it_shows: The individual plan terms let the vendor use chats to improve its models unless the user turns the setting off; they make no commitment about where data is processed; no business or data processing terms apply to the individual plan

title: Insurance agent's answer on the data breach expense endorsement
source_system: Insurance agent email
what_it_shows: The data breach expense endorsement has a $25,000 sublimit; notice to the carrier's breach hotline is required before outside vendors are hired; the hotline refers breach counsel

title: BIA self-review worksheet
source_system: CPA-owner's written BIA worksheet, reviewed with the IT consultant
what_it_shows: For each of the five business functions, the owner's account of the systems and vendors used, the manual workaround, and the longest outage and data loss the function can tolerate; the April 15 and October 15 deadlines drive return preparation and document intake, with the MTD for returns dropping to 24 hours in the last week before a deadline; extensions are the fallback while the owner can still file them; the owner is the only person who performs or authorizes each function

title: AI assistant chat history review
source_system: Generative AI assistant chat history (SYS-08)
what_it_shows: From 2026-02-02 to 2026-07-24 the chats hold uploaded brokerage composite 1099s, K-1s and three new clients' prior-year returns, and pasted IRS notice text, for about 70 clients (about 95 individual consumers counting spouses); full SSNs appear on the three prior-year returns and on 9 K-1s, and the other documents show masked numbers; one draft notice response cites a Code subsection that does not exist and one composite 1099 summary leaves out the wash sale loss disallowed amount, and neither reached a filed return or a sent letter; after the review the owner turned off the model-improvement setting and deleted those chats

title: SaaS and device mapping session
source_system: Printer-scanner, router, laptop and phone settings; home office, with the IT consultant
what_it_shows: The printer-scanner sends scans to the mailbox with the stored mailbox password over a basic sign-in method, and it can instead scan to a folder on the laptop; the router admin password is still the label default and family and smart-home devices share the one network; the laptop locks after 5 minutes idle and the phone after 1 minute, and both need the password or passcode to unlock; the home office room is locked when the owner is away and paper client files are in the locked cabinet

title: Gap analysis self-review
source_system: CPA-owner's written answers to the Safeguards Rule, IRC 7216 and IRS questions, checked on screen with the IT consultant
what_it_shows: The owner ran the program work informally and was never designated in writing as Qualified Individual; the 2024 change that turned off mailbox MFA was made without a review; the AI assistant, practice management SaaS and portal add-on were adopted without a security review; no subscription to security updates and no check of the owner's or the consultant's security knowledge; the owner did not know the IRS next-business-day report rule or Florida's 30-day notice clock; no incident log is kept; old laptops, phones and printer-scanners have no wipe procedure or record; passwords are long; the mailbox and synced client folders hold documents on more than 500 consumers

title: Portal consent and e-signature record check
source_system: Client portal consent and signature records (SYS-02)
what_it_shows: All 9 lender releases in 2026 were made after the client signed the IRC 7216 consent in the portal; signed Forms 8879 are stored back to 2019; 5 signed Forms 8879 checked each carry the e-signature identity verification record

title: Risk walk-through of devices, accounts and data locations
source_system: Walk-through of the laptop, phone, router and SaaS accounts with the IT consultant
what_it_shows: Where client data sits day to day (mailbox attachments, client folders back to 2014, laptop download folders, phone texts and camera roll with the photo backup, AI chat history, paper files and source document boxes); the laptop is the only workstation and holds browser-saved passwords; the two 2026 near misses; the router firmware has never been checked; files in progress stay on paper in the home office

title: Control assessment: Tax software account review
source_system: Tax software user list and audit log; accountant access list for client accounting files
what_it_shows: The user list held the owner's administrator account and the 2025 contract preparer's account with the preparer role, still enabled with a last sign-in on 2025-04-14; the audit log shows no sign-in on that account after 2025-04-14, and the owner disabled it during the test; the account was created after a phone call with no written approval; no account types, removal step or review record exist; account use is logged by the vendor and not monitored; the 12 accountant logins to client files were each added by client invitation

title: Control assessment: Activity review check and self-review
source_system: Email suite sign-in history and mailbox rules; tax software activity log; owner self-review
what_it_shows: No unknown forwarding rules, delegates or connected apps on the mailbox; sign-in history covers only 2026-06-29 onward, so the 2026-03-09 phishing near miss could not be checked; mailbox sign-ins, rules and the tax software activity log had never been reviewed; no process to act on review results or to increase review in filing season or after a phishing attempt

title: Control assessment: Backup review
source_system: Tax software vendor SOC 2 report; email suite version history settings; laptop storage; owner self-review
what_it_shows: The tax software vendor backs up returns and portal documents, encrypts the backups, checks their integrity and keeps them in a second location (SOC 2 report, no exceptions in backup testing); email and client folders have 30 days of version history only; laptop files and the security documents kept in the suite have no backup

title: Control assessment: Administrator MFA sign-in test
source_system: Tax software and email suite administrator sign-ins from a new browser
what_it_shows: Tax software administrator sign-in required the authenticator code; the email account, which is also the suite administrator, signed in with the password only

title: Control assessment: Practice management and portal MFA test
source_system: Practice management sign-in from a new browser; client portal MFA setting
what_it_shows: Practice management signed in with the password only, the same password as email; client portal MFA set to optional

title: Control assessment: Incident reporting self-review
source_system: Contact lists; vendor contracts (incident clauses); owner self-review
what_it_shows: No reporting time defined; the owner did not know the IRS next-business-day rule; the provider contracts do not require providers to report incidents to the firm; no list of whom to notify (IRS Stakeholder Liaison, insurer, counsel, FTC, state agencies)

title: Control assessment: Risk assessment review
source_system: P01 risk register; P05 BIA; owner self-review
what_it_shows: The 2026 risk assessment lists 15 threat events with sources and predisposing conditions, rates likelihood and impact with Tables G-5 and I-2, includes harm to clients from identity theft and refund fraud, takes the business view from the BIA, and is documented; results were shared with the IT consultant; no review frequency or update trigger was defined at the time of assessment

title: Control assessment: Service provider and remote-support review
source_system: Contracts folder; tax software vendor SOC 2 report; AI assistant and practice management terms; remote-support tool settings
what_it_shows: The AI assistant and practice management vendors were never held to a firm security requirement; the AI assistant's individual plan allowed use of chats to improve models until 2026-07-27; no required safeguards defined for providers; no vendor list or oversight steps documented; the tax software's customer responsibilities are listed in its SOC 2 report and the IT consultant's role in the 2026-07-23 agreement; only the tax software vendor is monitored (SOC 2 review 2026-07-28); the remote-support tool has no unattended access, and whether the consultant's own tool account uses MFA is not confirmed

title: Control assessment: Transmission of returns and documents
source_system: Email sent folder (2026 season); phone messages and camera roll; portal connection
what_it_shows: Portal and SaaS sessions use TLS; the sent folder holds 37 returns emailed to clients as plain attachments in the 2026 season; the phone holds 212 photos of client documents received by text (counted, not opened)

title: Control assessment: Malicious code protection test
source_system: Antivirus status page; standard antivirus test file downloaded
what_it_shows: The built-in antivirus detected the test file on download and quarantined it; signature updates install automatically (last update the same day); scheduled and real-time scans on; the default action quarantines detections; the alert was shown to the owner; no false positives recorded
